title: docs(audits): archive eleven closed 2026-06 liveness audits, with the spec ledger notes that cite them
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEWyq4TR24cs3kXM8Hhr1WG)_
Fixes #26257

Claim: 6470176009
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

The fuller arm of the card, as the claim scopes it: the 11 closed 2026-06 property-liveness audits whose every citation can be rewritten move to `docs/audits/archive/2026-06/`, with each citation rewritten. Only path text inside notes and docs moves. No liveness status, evidence row, schema, accept set or export changes.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 11 份已关闭的 2026-06 属性存活审计从 `docs/audits/` 移进 `docs/audits/archive/2026-06/`，`packages/spec/liveness/*.json` 里引用它们的 `_note` 路径、两份 README 和一处审计正文同步改写。
- **为什么改：** #26075 的裁决 A 要求关闭的审计归档；#26925 已移走 4 份无引用的，这次是 spec 引用的那部分。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改注释性路径文字，`_note` 不参与任何校验；`@objectstack/spec` 发 patch（`liveness/` 在其 `files[]` 里）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `docs/audits/README.md`（新增的「保留原位」说明与 12 行改动）、`packages/spec/liveness/README.md` L7、任一 `packages/spec/liveness/*.json` 第 3 行。
- **两分钟验证：** `git grep -nE "audits/2026-06-(action|agent|dashboard|field|flow|hook|object|report|skill|tool|view)schema"` → 零命中。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Moved (`git mv`, nothing deleted), 11 files** into `docs/audits/archive/2026-06/`: `2026-06-{action,agent,dashboard,field,flow,hook,object,report,skill,tool,view}schema-property-liveness.md`. None of them has an outbound relative link, so no link inside them needed re-rooting.
- **`@objectstack/spec`, `liveness/*.json`.** The `_note` of action, agent, dashboard, field, flow, hook, object, report, skill, tool and view names `docs/audits/archive/2026-06/...` instead of `docs/audits/...`. One line in each file.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/README.md` L7.** The `docs/audits/2026-06-*-property-liveness.md` glob now names the archive and says the ones still cited from an ADR or a changelog stay in `docs/audits/`.
- **`docs/audits/README.md`.** 11 table rows and the report-slice link point into `archive/2026-06/`. A new note under the lifecycle line records which closed audits stay in place and why (ADR-cited, or cited from the published `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`).
- **`docs/audits/2026-06-record-search-liveness.md` L34.** Its bare mention of the fieldschema audit names the archive path. That file stays in place because ADR-0061 cites it, but it is an audit, not an ADR, so its text can change.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/26257-archive-2026-06-liveness-audits.md`, `@objectstack/spec` patch, with both declaration lines.

### Staying in place by design (9 files)

- **Cited from the release-owned `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` (3):** `2026-06-appschema-property-liveness` (CHANGELOG L77148, L101255), `2026-06-dead-surface-disposition-plan` (L67997, L110039) and `2026-06-validationschema-property-liveness` (L113020, L113790). Seat 1 ruled in the claim that a stale path in a published changelog is worse than an unarchived audit. So their zod comments (`app.zod.ts` L1607, `field.zod.ts` L1956/L1976/L2005, `validation.zod.ts` L53), the `field.json` `_note` mention of the disposition plan and `content/docs/references/data/validation.mdx` do not change.
- **ADR-cited (6), untouched:** `handwritten-docs-accuracy-followups` (ADR-0112), `metadata-functional-completeness` (ADR-0078), `react-blocks-conformance` and `react-tier-authoring-dogfood` (ADR-0082), `record-search-liveness` (ADR-0061) and `security-identity-property-liveness` (ADR-0049, also `liveness/permission.json`). No ADR is edited.

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so no test is added. The liveness suites that read `liveness/*.json` were re-run on this head (below).

## Acceptance notes

- Census taken on `origin/main` `0cd578f7` for each of the 20 remaining files: `git grep -F BASENAME` over the whole tree (packages, content, docs, skills, scripts, ui), plus a sweep for `audits/2026-06` and `2026-06-*` globs. No script, test or skill pins a `_note` path or the "Seeded from docs/audits/..." spelling.
- No package `CHANGELOG.md` cites any of the 11 moved files.

## Verification

All readings on head `9876aa877`, tree `objectstack-ai/objectstack`.

<details><summary>No reference to a moved file's old location</summary>

For each of the 11 basenames, `git grep -n BASENAME -- . ':!packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md'` with every `archive/2026-06/` hit removed: 0 lines for every file. `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` exit 0. `pnpm check:doc-authoring` exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Spec build, generated artifacts and liveness suites (under os-verify-lock)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date" (`check:docs` content/docs/references included, so nothing under `references/` moves).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/liveness scripts/count-shards-merge.test.ts`: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 13 passed (13), Tests 369 passed (369).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:liveness`: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates: 60 derived, 59 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE`: "60 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 59 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". The one NOT MEASURED is `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist`, 85+ packages unbuilt here); CI's Lint & Repo Gates runs it. `check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 for the same reason and were re-run green after building the `@objectstack/lint` and `@objectstack/objectql` closures. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone, then exit 0.

</details>
